en-US.promotionalText: Meet the Artemis III crew, follow Artemis II to splashdown, and get mission alerts the moment they break.
en-US.description:
Artemis Tracker is the dedicated companion for NASA's return to the Moon.

Follow Artemis II in real time — precise countdown to launch, TLI, lunar flyby and splashdown — and get the full picture on Artemis III as the mission takes shape.

WHAT YOU GET
• Live countdown to every Artemis II milestone from launch through splashdown.
• Full crew profiles for Artemis II (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen) and the announced Artemis III crew.
• Mission overview with SLS, Orion, Starship HLS and Gateway context.
• Remote banners that surface NASA announcements, schedule shifts and live events the moment they break.
• Curated launch history and key mission documents.

ARTEMIS BRIEFING (PREMIUM)
Go premium to unlock the Artemis Briefing — Wednesday deep-dives and a short Sunday Week Ahead, plus member-only mission notes inside the app. Sober editorial coverage, no clickbait. Cancel anytime.

BUILT BY SPACE NERDS
Made by an independent developer who watches every launch. No ads, no tracking gimmicks, just a clean tool for following the Moon program.

Clear skies.
